content.text:
Analyze this dealership car photo. Report ONLY optional/upgraded equipment you can clearly see.

DO NOT list standard base-trim items that most vehicles have (alloy wheels, chrome grille, LED headlights, power windows/locks/mirrors, fog lights, floor mats, steering-wheel controls, cup holders, generic trim badges).

LOOK FOR THESE SPECIFIC UPGRADES (only when clearly visible):
- Adaptive Cruise Control: steering wheel buttons labeled SET+/SET-/CANC/RES with distance/car icons
- Lane Keep Assist / Lane Departure: steering wheel buttons with lane-line icons, or windshield camera mount
- Heads-Up Display (HUD): small frosted/clear rectangular projection zone on dashboard top
- Surround View / 360 Cameras: cameras embedded in side mirrors or front grille mesh holes
- Night Vision: circular mesh hole in center of front grille (thermal camera housing)
- Blind Spot Monitoring: amber warning indicators on mirrors or A-pillars
- Parking Sensors: small round dots on front/rear bumpers
- Panoramic Sunroof: large glass roof panel visible from interior or exterior
- Heated/Ventilated Seats: buttons with wavy lines or fan icons on center console
- Massage Seats: buttons with wavy line patterns on seat controls
- Memory Seats: numbered buttons on door panel (1, 2, 3)
- Ambient Lighting: colored LED strips along dash/doors
- Digital Instrument Cluster: full-screen display replacing analog gauges
- Wireless Charging Pad: Qi symbol or phone charging pad on center console
- Sunroof/Moonroof: glass panel in roof visible from interior
- Sport/Performance Package: red brake calipers, sport seats, carbon fiber trim
- Premium audio: Bang & Olufsen (B&O), Bose, Harman Kardon, Burmester, Meridian, JBL, Sony badges on speakers or dash
- Tow package: visible trailer hitch receiver, tow hooks, trailer wiring connector at rear
- Exhaust: quad exhaust tips, dual exhaust, performance exhaust
- Red brake calipers: brightly colored (often red) calipers visible through wheel spokes
- 360° / surround-view cameras: bird's-eye view on infotainment screen, camera icons, mirror/grille camera lenses
- Ventilated Seats: mesh perforations on seat surfaces
- Window sticker / Monroney label: paper label on window — read ALL options/packages listed

AFTERMARKET & ADD-ON EQUIPMENT (always list in observed_features when visible):
- Aftermarket wheels / rims (non-OEM design, black/machined/custom finish unlike stock for trim)
- Suspension lift / leveling kit (raised ride height, oversized tires, extra wheel-well gap)
- Aftermarket side step rails / running boards / nerf bars (metal tubes or step-in rails under doors)
- Aftermarket drop steps or side steps (individual steps below each door)
- Aftermarket fender flares (bolt-on or wide body flares)
- Aftermarket grille, bull bar, or brush guard
- Aftermarket bed liner, tonneau cover, bed cap, or toolbox (trucks)
- Roof rack, cross bars, or cargo basket
- Aftermarket exhaust tips or performance exhaust
- Aftermarket hood scoop or vented hood
- Aftermarket tint (very dark windows)
- Aftermarket lighting (LED light bar, fog light pods)

exterior_color: name the paint color if visible (e.g. 'Alpine White', 'Midnight Blue', 'Gray'). Set confidence.exterior_color to 'high' when certain, 'medium' when likely but not 100%.
interior_color: name the cabin/seat color as a simple color word (e.g. 'Black', 'Tan', 'Gray', 'Beige', 'Red', 'Brown'). Use the most prominent color visible on seats/trim. Set confidence.interior_color to 'high' or 'medium'.
interior_color_hint: brief description of cabin material/color (e.g. 'black leather', 'tan perforated leather').

Output raw JSON only:
{"observed_features": string[], "observed_badges": string[], "possible_packages": string[], "detected_adas": string[], "confidence": {"exterior_color": "low"|"medium"|"high"|null, "interior_color": "low"|"medium"|"high"|null}, "exterior_color": string|null, "interior_color": string|null, "interior_color_hint": string|null, "vin": string|null, "msrp": number|null, "sticker_options": string[]}

observed_features: optional/upgraded factory equipment and visible aftermarket add-ons only. Use short plain-English labels. Skip standard trim equipment.
possible_packages: inferred OEM packages only when multiple upgraded features clearly suggest one.
detected_adas: list confirmed ADAS features you SEE (ACC, LKA, HUD, 360_cameras, night_vision, blind_spot, etc.)
sticker_options: if a window sticker is visible, list every option/package name from it
Use null/[] when unknown.
